backtest_protocol.execution_model: Issuer event confirmation is derived from canonical daily earnings snapshot transitions. Issuer and peer OHLCV are observed through the peer signal-date close; Companyfacts contexts are max_filed at the window end and queried by signal date; paper entry is next open and exit is ten trading days after signal.

late_strong.relation_field: same-sector PIT Companyfacts plus OHLCV characteristic similarity

mid_weak.relation_field: same-sector PIT Companyfacts plus OHLCV characteristic similarity

old_thin.relation_field: same-sector PIT Companyfacts plus OHLCV characteristic similarity

gate2.note: The sleeve uses only same-day and trailing OHLCV fields plus next-open/exit prices available to the replay. It does not ask LLM or production to infer hidden fields.

ohlcv.decision_time: known after peer signal-day close before next-open paper entry

peer_relation.relation: same-sector PIT Companyfacts plus OHLCV characteristic similarity

runtime_fields: SPY OHLCV rows for same-window relative strength

gate3.note: No core filter or live entry rule was added. The target source is additive default-off paper, so core survival is unchanged.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool / entry: positive earnings-surprise reactions may transfer to peers only when the peer is fundamentally and technically similar enough to the issuer.

2_history_check.exp-20260531-010: SEC Item 2.02 characteristic similarity failed; this run uses confirmed positive EPS surprise plus issuer reaction, not SEC filing events alone.
2_history_check.exp-20260602-012: Exact-industry post-earnings peer transfer failed robustness and sample/concentration gates.
2_history_check.exp-20260602-019: Same-sector post-earnings peer transfer regressed old_thin and showed relation noise.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Same three docs/backtesting.md windows; positive aggregate EV/PnL; 3/3 EV-improved windows; no PnL-regressed window; >=20 paper trades across all 3 windows; drawdown drift <=0.5pp; survival >=5%; concentration inside guardrails.

hypothesis: Positive EPS-surprise issuer reactions may transfer to peers only when issuer and peer share point-in-time Companyfacts and OHLCV characteristics, reducing relation noise versus same-sector or exact-industry links.
interpretation: The post-earnings characteristic-similarity peer-transfer source did not clear Gate 4. Do not promote it or retry nearby peer relation thresholds on these frozen windows without forward rows or a stronger relation source.
next_evidence_needed: Forward replacement-value rows or a stronger peer relation source such as audited customer/supplier links, source overlap, or multi-season early-peer earnings transfer evidence.

source_definition: event issuer has PIT earnings snapshot transition-confirmed positive EPS surprise
issuer event-day return beats SPY by at least 1pp and closes in upper 55% of range
candidate is a different same-sector ticker
issuer and candidate share at least 5 characteristic fields and 2 fundamental fields
candidate characteristic similarity score is at least 0.55
candidate has signal-day return beating SPY by at least 0.3pp
candidate event-to-signal return beats SPY and has positive 20d RS
candidate is liquid, above prior 50d average, and close_location >= 0.55
top-1 selected paper entry per signal date

prediction.confidence_reason: Same-sector and exact-industry peer transfer failed robustness, but the playbook identifies characteristic-similarity peer relations as the correct retry path after raw relation failures.

production_parity.parity_note: No production code path is changed. A future promotion would need the exact relation field moved into a shared default-off adapter using the same earnings snapshot, sector-map, Companyfacts, and OHLCV inputs available to production before next-open paper entry.

why_not_other_changes: Skipped LLM soft-ranking because replay-safe soft-ranking rows are still insufficient. Skipped Companyfacts source/provenance retunes, FINRA, VBB, consensus, Space, and state-surface scalar retunes because the current playbook requires materially new forward rows or fields before retrying those families. This tests a distinct free-data relation-construction field.
